text: ShortsOS keeps four facts about each capability apart on purpose: whether it is built, how strongly a real run proves it, who can reach it today, and what may be said about it in public. The last of those four is never set by hand; it is derived, and any single failing condition keeps a capability below a public claim instead of being averaged away. Three concepts sit in a blocked column that no amount of evidence can lift: customers publishing to Instagram without the team, customers linking their own Google Drive, and general promises about creative quality.
